firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently sang, hummed, or whistled like a cute little gnome is the starting player.
clarifications: Play proceeds clockwise from the starting player.
To balance the starting-player advantage, the second and third players each move one Sound disc forward during setup; the fourth player moves two.
